# IPinfo

IPinfo.io provides a comprehensive API for IP address geolocation and related data.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/ipinfo-io/.

## Actions

- **Batch IP Lookup** (read-only): Perform batch IP lookups.
- **Batch Lite Lookup** (read-only): Perform bulk Lite IP lookups.
- **Get Abuse Contact** (read-only): Retrieve abuse contact information for a specific IP address.
- **Get Company Info for an IP** (read-only): Retrieve company info for a specific IP.
- **Get IP Carrier Info** (read-only): Get carrier information for a given IP address.
- **Get IP Information** (read-only): Retrieve detailed information about an IP address.
- **Get IP Privacy Details** (read-only): Retrieve privacy-related flags (VPN, proxy, Tor, relay, hosting) for an IP address.
